article.title: Hybrid attention architecture study
article.summary: A hybrid architecture uses mostly bounded-state attention layers and a smaller number of precise retrieval layers to reduce long-context memory costs without losing critical recall.
article.visual_thesis: A 3:1 hybrid stack retains selective full-attention retrieval while replacing most growing KV cache with compact recurrent state.
global_must_avoid: generic AI robot or glowing brain
unrelated office workers operating a machine
server city, factory, or decorative gears with no architecture mapping

visual_bible.world_summary: A domain-faithful paper-cutout model architecture built from layered attention modules, state capsules, token ribbons, and comparison tracks on one restrained parchment field.
visual_bible.background: Warm aged parchment with subtle fiber texture, faint map grid, and two gentle diagonal creases.
palette: dark ink brown for outlines and structure
muted sage for retained compact state
dusty indigo for full-attention retrieval and KV comparison
warm brick red for growing memory cost
visual_bible.lighting: Soft warm light from upper left; short soft shadows fall to lower right.
visual_bible.character_system: No human figures by default; architecture modules, token cards, memory capsules, and comparison tracks carry the narrative.
visual_bible.recurring_motif: one ochre token ribbon passing through every architecture module
continuity_rules: Keep the same parchment tone and grid strength.
Keep the same camera angle and short lower-right shadows.
Keep terracotta for bounded-state modules and indigo for full-attention modules.
Do not render text in the base image.
Keep the same paper-tag annotation style and color semantics.
Semantic component identity outranks decorative style choices.

shots.anchor: The architecture interleaves three bounded-state layers with one full-attention retrieval layer.
shots.core_idea: The hybrid stack preserves precise retrieval in one layer while shifting most layers to compact recurrent state.
shots.composition: Center one four-module paper architecture stack: three terracotta bounded-state modules and one indigo full-attention retrieval module interleaved in a single stack. An ochre token ribbon passes through all four modules. Beside the stack, contrast a compact sage state capsule with a visibly lengthening brick-red KV card trail. Reserve quiet parchment pockets above and at the outer sides without hiding the layer topology.
motion_cues: token cards enter the first module at staggered positions
the compact state capsule remains fixed while the KV-card trail grows
the single indigo retrieval layer reconnects distant token cards

source_basis: Three bounded-state attention layers are interleaved with one full-attention retrieval layer.
The bounded-state path keeps recurrent memory compact while the full-attention comparison accumulates KV cache with context length.
must_show: one four-layer stack containing three bounded-state modules and one full-attention module
a token stream crossing the interleaved modules in sequence
a compact recurrent state contrasted with a growing KV cache trail
must_not_show: four disconnected machines that do not form one model stack
generic workers, robot, brain, server city, or decorative factory

shots.alt_text: A four-layer paper architecture uses three bounded-state modules and one full-attention layer, beside a fixed state capsule and a growing KV cache trail.
shots.caption: The hybrid keeps most layers on a bounded-state path while retaining one precise retrieval layer.

headline.text: Most layers keep state compact; one layer restores exact retrieval

motion_beats: The four interleaved modules and token ribbon appear.
Tokens pass through three bounded-state modules and one retrieval module.
The recurrent state stays compact while the comparison KV trail lengthens.
The architecture holds as one readable resource-and-retrieval trade-off.
